content_type: text/plain (trimmed text excerpt of a text-layer PDF)
trim_rule: Keep the circular's own identity lines (Download Ref No, Circular Ref. No, Sub, the 'applicable with effect from <date>' sentence), the SEBI uniform-charge directive it cites, the two predecessor circular refs and dates, the 'level levied prior to <date>' sentence, the NSE/FA/56129 DELTA PARAGRAPH verbatim, and the rate table VERBATIM from its 'Segment Existing outflow' header to the end of the Equity Options row. Dropped: the letterhead and contact block, the NSE/FA/64323 narrative paragraph, the closing 'For and on behalf of' and signatory. The 56129 delta paragraph is KEPT rather than dropped because it is the only place the pre-2023-04-01 level is stated -- as differences (-20/-10/-300 on the transaction charge, +9.99/+49.99 on IPFT) rather than as a rate. The module reconstructs that level from it and labels the result `derived`; without the paragraph the fixture would not support the reconstruction at all. Extractable text is 3,083 characters of a 163,365-byte PDF; the remaining bytes are an embedded letterhead image and carry no rate.
